picker.title: Pick a {{slot}} visual
picker.subtitle: Selecting an asset updates your combo and the prompt immediately.

assets.title: Pick visuals first, then shape the image.
assets.body: You do not have to start from a blank prompt. Choose character, pose, outfit, scene and style assets first — WebToMind turns the selection into a reproducible image prompt.

bullets.0: 16 visual slots cover identity, composition, lens and style
bullets.1: Use official assets, or upload images to reverse into your library
bullets.2: Every pick updates the current combo instantly

prompt.title: The prompt compiler turns choices into a full brief.
prompt.body: Use the compiled version, or switch to custom mode and write directly. Negative constraints can live at the bottom of the main prompt.

bullets.0: Copy, save presets and import prompts from the same panel
bullets.1: Structure check starts as a score, with details on demand
bullets.2: Size, quality and format are sent as generation parameters

reference.title: Upload references to keep characters consistent.
reference.body: When you need the same character across many images, upload references first, then open the character workflow to manage cards and A/B grouping.

bullets.0: Use 1-3 refs for one character, up to 4 for two characters
bullets.1: Check identity, outfit and grouping drift after generation
bullets.2: Import previous generations as new references

tasks.title: Generate, retry and build your reusable library.
tasks.body: Image jobs appear in the AI task panel. Successful results land in history; failed jobs can be edited and retried, and system failures are refunded.

bullets.0: Actual credit cost is shown before generation; failures refund
bullets.1: History images can be copied, edited, downloaded or added to projects
bullets.2: Save good combinations as presets for one-click reuse
